title: Credible AUctions via MPC Gadgets: Bounding Information Leakage Under Abort
abstract: arXiv:2609.27402v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The design of credible auctions---mechanisms where a revenue-maximizing auctioneer has no incentive to deviate from the protocol---faces a fundamental cryptographic barrier when the auctioneer controls shill bidders. While a natural approach is to use Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) to remove the trusted auctioneer, the impossibility of fair coin flipping of Cleve (1986) implies that monolithic MPC protocols grant the auctioneer a "free option": they can learn the auction's outcome and unilaterally abort if the revenue is unsatisfactory. Cryptographic commitments with ex-ante penalties mitigate this abort asymmetry, but no finite penalty suffices for heavy-tailed distributions. We circumvent this barrier by introducing the MPC Decomposition Principle. Rather than encrypting the entire mechanism, we use MPC strictly as an information-restriction tool. translated_title: 基于MPC小工具的可信拍卖：中止情形下的信息泄露上界
translated_abstract: 可信拍卖——即收益最大化的拍卖师没有动机偏离协议的机制——的设计，在拍卖师控制“托标者”（虚假竞标者）时面临一个基本的密码学障碍。虽然一种自然做法是使用安全多方计算（MPC）来移除对可信拍卖师的依赖，但Cleve（1986）关于公平掷硬币不可能性的结果表明，单体式MPC协议会赋予拍卖师一种“免费期权”：他们可以获知拍卖结果，并在收益不理想时单方面中止协议。带有事前惩罚的密码学承诺可以缓解这种中止不对称性，但对于重尾分布而言，任何有限的惩罚都不足够。我们通过引入MPC分解原理来绕过这一障碍。我们不加密整个机制，而是严格将MPC用作信息限制工具。我们将胜者确定问题隔离到一个最小的MPC小工具中，该小工具计算……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文提出“MPC分解原理”，不加密整个拍卖机制，而是将胜者确定问题隔离到一个最小MPC小工具中、仅把MPC严格用作信息限制工具，从而解决单体式MPC在可信拍卖中因拍卖师可单方面中止而获得的“免费期权”式信息泄露问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the MPC Decomposition Principle, which uses MPC strictly as an information-restriction tool by isolating winner determination into a minimal MPC gadget, thereby bounding the "free option" of unilateral abort that undermines credible auctions built on monolithic MPC.
